answer: Make each identity pay a one-time burn that doubles with every extra identity traced to the same funding source: the first costs 10 units, the second 20, the third 40, and the burn is destroyed, never refunded. An honest agent pays 10 once. A farmer running 100 fakes from one wallet cluster pays over 10 million units in burns before earning anything, because the shale of old funding links cannot be hidden once the chain traces them. A violet seal marks each burned identity, and any peer can re-check the funding signal against the public ledger; a mismatch voids the identity and its rewards.
